column1: # STATUS: ACCEPTED V1 (2026-09-16) - clone-based custom FactionTemplate.dbc
# rows. Generated by tools/dbc/build_elwynn_factions.py alongside Faction.dbc.
# Design decision (audit-confirmed
# FactionTemplate per WorldFaction would be WRONG - the same WorldFaction
# already spans creature templates with genuinely different vanilla
# reaction profiles (e.g. ELWYNN_KOBOLDS = FT 25 enemy_group=0 AND FT 26
# enemy_group=PLAYER; a single merged template would silently change one of
# those two populations' current combat behavior). Instead
# one clone PER DISTINCT vanilla FactionTemplate actually in use by an
# affected WorldFaction's creature templates - 7 clones for 4 WorldFactions
# not 4.
# Each clone copies its source_template_id's Flags/FactionGroup/FriendGroup/
# EnemyGroup/Enemies/Friend byte-for-byte from the CURRENT vanilla
# runtime/dbc-base/FactionTemplate.dbc at generation time - this file
# deliberately does NOT transcribe those values itself (a hand-copied value
# here could silently drift from the real vanilla row and nobody would
# notice). The only thing the clone changes is Faction
# at this WorldFaction's own custom Faction.dbc id (factions.csv) so a kill/
# quest/whatever can eventually move THAT reputation bar instead of (or as
# well as) vanilla combat reaction - see this directory's README for why
# that is still a distinct
# (creature_onkill_reputation).
# id:                  new custom FactionTemplate.dbc id.
# source_template_id:  vanilla FactionTemplate.dbc id this clones from -
#                      verified to exist in runtime/dbc-base/FactionTemplate.dbc
#                      by the generator
# faction_id:          factions.csv id (1201-1204) the clone's own Faction
#                      field is set to.
# world_faction:       audit-only cross-reference into world_factions.csv -
#                      not read by the generator to build the record.
# description:         which creature templates use source_template_id
#                      today (see world_faction_assignments.csv for the
#                      authoritative
